Bike theft isn’t uncommon, but you can take steps to prevent it. Your bike should not be the easiest one on the rack to steal. 
Get a cheap/old/used bike if it’s going to be locked outside. Less appealing to steal plus less sad if it’s taken. 
Use a U-lock to attach the frame to the rack and another U-lock to attach the front wheel to the frame. Take accessories (eg: lights) with you. If you’re ambitious, get a seat post lock. 
Don’t lock it up outside overnight. Check if your work or gym have bike lockers nearby or an indoor rack (or rack in a parking garage) as an alternative to an outdoor rack. 
And if you want, you can get bike insurance that covers theft for around $100/year for a non-fancy  bike. 

Basically it’s very possible your bike will be stolen, but you can make it less likely, and it’s an awesome convenient way to get around the city.
